description: Na₂Ta₂(P₂O₇)₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.38 Å. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.97 Å) and three longer (1.98 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-42°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.62 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ta and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ta and one P atom.
